name: Air Fryer Fish Sticks with Lemon-Yogurt Herb Sauce

instructions.primary_message: Place bread crumbs in a medium bowl. Set aside.
Place egg in another medium bowl. Whisk to combine and set aside.
Pat cod dry with paper towels, then cut crosswise into 1-inch thick strips. Sprinkle with Old Bay seasoning (and additional salt, if desired) on the top side.
instructions.secondary_message:
454 g cod fillet
½ tsp Old Bay seasoning
¼ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Working with one strip at a time, dip cod in the egg mixture, allowing excess to drip off. Transfer to the bowl with the bread crumbs and turn to coat (press gently with your fingers to adhere). Transfer fish sticks to a large plate.

Spray air fryer basket with cooking spray. Working in batches to best fit the size of your air fryer, add fish sticks to the basket, spacing them at least ½-inch apart. Coat with additional cooking spray.
Insert basket into the air fryer and set temperature to 400°F. Cook until fish sticks are golden, crispy, and cooked through, 8-10 minutes. Remove basket from air fryer.
Meanwhile, wash, dry, and juice lemon into a small bowl.

Wash and dry parsley. Using a clean cutting board, shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl with the lemon juice along with yogurt, mayo, and spices. Whisk to combine the sauce.
instructions.secondary_message:
¼ small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley
½ cup plain Greek yogurt
3 tbsp mayonnaise
½ tsp dill, dried
¼ tsp garlic powder
¼ tsp salt
⅛ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide fish sticks and sauce between plates. Enjoy!
